capabilities: Turn shell commands into command palette entries
Fill command variables from the vault path, active file and its frontmatter
Dispatch the active note to Claude Code or another CLI agent
Show a status bar count of running Claude Code sessions
Show a notice when an agent finishes or needs input
disambiguation: Not an embedded terminal; it runs your commands in an external terminal app.
extras: Desktop only; the Focus terminal option uses open -a and is macOS only. Claude Code status needs a hook script added to the vault by hand and does not cover sessions that were already open. Installed by copying release files into the plugins folder.
problem: Obsidian cannot hand the note you are reading to a local shell command or CLI coding agent, and gives no signal when that agent finishes or needs input.

relations.evidence: hand the note to Claude Code, Codex, or any CLI agent in a new terminal window
hand the note to Claude Code, Codex, or any CLI agent in a new terminal window
Both use sesh window connect, which opens a new window in the vault's session

summary: Turns shell commands into command palette entries that run on the active note, and reports when Claude Code sessions finish.
